_comment: PRE-REGISTERED candidate designs and selection criterion for P3 and Q3. Fixed before any held-out (WikiText-2 / C4-validation / HellaSwag) result is produced. Selection uses ONLY the 32-sequence C4 development manifest. The sha256 of each block is stored in the selection lock; changing this file after selection invalidates the lock and the test-time stages refuse to run. Unsuccessful designs are retained in results/task1/selection/*.json.

q3.quantizer: Q2 AWQ-style (fixed); only bit widths change
